description: This file defines routing logic for FastAPI, including route decorators, route classes, and functions for handling dependencies, WebSocket endpoints, and integration with Starlette routing. It includes classes such as APIRoute, APIRouter, and WebSocketRoute, along with functions for processing requests, responses, and middleware.

classes.name: APIWebSocketRoute

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: Router class to group multiple routes and include other routers, with support for tags, dependencies, and route overrides.
